programme.title: 猛鬼佛跳牆
programme.desc: It is a dream come true for engineer Bill Cheung when a quiet villa in the countryside is assigned to him as staff quarters. As soon as he moves into this extravagant estate with his wife and 2 daughters, strange things begin to happen. When his daughter Jane discovers the previous owners were burned to death many years ago, Bill's family is already on their way to a similar tragic demise..

programme.title: 影人映語 -電影旦—鄭丹瑞
programme.desc: Lawrence Cheng has been working in the film industry over 40 years who was known with his friends in the 1980s as the creator of The Yuppie Fantasia franchise. In this episode, Cheng shares his motive of creation and key to success of such franchise, as well as how he got obsessed with film as teen. Looking back, he admits that he was not a very competent director and reveals more unforgettable stories of the past.

programme.title: 太子爺出差
programme.desc: Te-pei sets up an Angel's Dust scan but finds himself trapped by Hong Kong police led by Chang. They are ordered to cooperate to crack the narcotize ring and suspect rich Chen as the kingpin. This leads to a Yunan martial arts troupe. Chang falls in love with the troupe's star, Hung. Police raid the troupe but find nothing as Hung has unwittingly taken the narcotics. She wants to smuggle herself to America, only to find herself chased by police and traffickers..

programme.title: 九二黑玫瑰對黑玫瑰
programme.desc: As soon as Tony Leung, starts imitating the stilted dialogue of 60s heartthrob Lui Kei, film lovers know they've entered a circle of movie-in-jokes and self-conscious world.

programme.title: 八喜臨門
programme.desc: The Ng family: Doctor Ng, Mrs. Ng, Ng Chee, Ng Lei and Ng Choi went to picnic happily. Hereon, different romances happened between them: First of all, Lei was attracted by Macdonna, a very sexy girl; Chee loved little Rambo who saved her from two 'teddy' boys; Choi loved her elder cousin who was graduated from a foreign university and had not found a job yet; Mrs. Ng decided to apply for the post of actress for a drama association. Billy, the director of the drama was the divorced father of little Rambo. He fell in love with Mrs. Ng at the first sight..

programme.title: 黃飛鴻之二男兒當自強
programme.desc: During his stay in Canton, Wong Fei Hung meets Sun Yat Sun and Luke. He decides to help them escape by the 'cover' from the rioting White Lotus Sect.

programme.title: 錢作怪
programme.desc: Ricky and Fatso are friends in need. They are in dire need of money since they are only paid slave wages at the bottling factory. By nature, Ricky is a dreamer. In his day dreams, he is romancing with Jo Jo, the movie idol. Ricky and Fatso buy a lottery ticket and become millionaires overnight. In one of these nights out in town, Ricky is suddenly attacked by an upset stomach. In no time, a quack doctor diagnoses the seizure as terminal cancer. Ricky seriously considers suicide. But he is also appalled by the drawbacks inherent in the many methods of doing himself in primarily the pain. It is on a rooftop from which he is supposed to make a plunge that he saves a poor man from suicide by giving the latter all the money he has. In gratitude, the newly rich man promises to hire a killer to finish off his suffering benefactor..

programme.title: 拳王
programme.desc: Silent classmate Ming, an ambitious boxing addict, decides to learn boxing in Thailand after a technical knockdown in a contest which he was confident of winning. By witnessing the rigorous training on the spot, he not only develops the physique of a boxer but enhances the dignity and dauntless spirit of the boxer in a tournament. Tak is another young upcoming boxer. He learned Chinese martial arts from his father since childhood. Not wanting to be cooped up in the narrow confines of boxing only, he undergoes hard training in Thai boxing in a gym, hoping to widen the boxing horizon..

programme.title: 阿飛正傳
programme.desc: A self-obsessed man, desperately seeking his true identity, York plays carelessly with his lovers and his friends before leaving them all to the Philippines in search of the truth..

programme.title: 時光倒流1994: 洪熙官
programme.desc: Hung Hei Kwun, a kungfu student of Shaolin, is against the Manchu rulers. Hung's whole family was arrested and later beheaded. Hung killed Ning-Erh Ma in revenge and escaped with his youngest son, Man-Ting, to nowhere land. Several years later, Chishan, Father Superior of the Shaolin Temple, found a map to a treasure trove but contents were tattooed on the backs of his five young masters. If missing one master, the trove could not be found..

programme.title: 天涯海角
programme.desc: Kelly, suffers from leukemia, encounters a sailor named Michael who comes from the North Sea of Scotland. Love comes and goes until Takeshi comes to her life..

programme.title: 知法犯法
programme.desc: Police constable Mike is suspended from duty charged with abusing the use of his gun in a robbery. During his suspension from duty, Mike meets a Triad Society Big Brother, Tin, and admires his lifestyle and also his sexy wife. Mike is apparently dismissed but in fact becoming a stoolie. Mike eventually becomes Tin's bodyguard, and discovers that his buddy Chung also becomes a stoolie. Mike uses the Police Force to get rid of all big brothers and intends to become the head of the Society, as well as taking over Tin's wife. For his own sake, Mike even kills his buddy Chung and kidnaps Tin..

programme.title: 百變星君
programme.desc: Sing met Bonnie, a secret lover of a gang and is bombed for revenge. Only his mouth, brain and penis can still function. The doctor proposed the 'Sixty Million Dollar Man' plan..

programme.title: 黃飛鴻
programme.desc: Set in 1875, China. Wong Fei Hung and his disciples take on the unscrupulous dealers who are trying to entice gullible Chinese into slavery in America.

programme.title: 不死情謎
programme.desc: Sam and his team are members of a Serious Crime Unit in the District Crime Squad, conducting a crackdown on an international crime organization trafficking in the human cargo of illegal immigrants. The team successfully dissolves the group and destroys its power in Southeast Asia. They arrest one of the group's leaders, Night. At the court, Night is charged with several offences and is being prosecuted by Sam's fiancee, Ann. Ann tries her best to convict Night for all the crimes he committed. However, the defense lawyer is tough and manipulative and finally, Night is convicted on only one of the charges in human smuggling and sentenced to three years imprisonment. Night is unrepentant and vows to take his revenge and destroy the couple one day. During the lawyer's visit, Night relays this message to his brother, Day, and asks Day to carry out the revenge for him..

programme.title: 衛斯理之霸王卸甲
programme.desc: This is a film about one of the practical metaphysics of the Orient - Geomancy. The Orientals believe fervently that a good burial site endows fame and fortune on its descendants. When the story begins, two geomancers are roaming Indochina's wilderness trying to find the dream grave site. They find The Conqueror, a site generating wealth and power - also a bloodbath. Nguen wants it but Wei wants no bloodbath. They have a fight. Wei escapes by the skin of his teeth. Wei rewards the poor man who saved him by finding him a good grave site. Many years later, Anna who is believed to be the daughter of the poor man, heads an American computer empire. Wei's son, Wisely, is a famous traveler. The girl asks him to go to Indochina to trace their roots..

programme.title: 龍鳳智多星
programme.desc: Taiwanese detective Simon visits Hong Kong and is served by Wing, the young and witty cop. Their adventures begin when they encounter two pretty girls, Pretty eyes and Slant eyes. These two girls are pickpockets and have stolen a jade from the professional killer. The killer is desperate to get back his treasure, that even though the detectives try to protect the sisters, the four are in great danger..

programme.title: 代客泊車
programme.desc: Stanley was an optimistic youth, feeling bored in his pig-rearing job, he decided to part with his beloved uncle and aunt and seek for an ideal job to achieve his own goal in life. He then found a job in Tsim Sha Tsui East. There he worked as a member of a parking service team and befriended one of his colleagues Ah Man. Ah Man was a reticent guy who was always frustrated by reality. The problem that he could not afford his sister to further studies in oversea puzzled him now and then. His anxiety was intensified by his sorrowful devotion to a mysterious beautiful girl Stella. Stanley was enthusiastic to help Ah Man to be acquainted with Stella. This made Ah Man live in high spirits. Stanley also encouraged his colleagues to work with enthusiasm. Their team was therefore rewarded with more tips by customers. A member of another team was a man of misconduct who stole spare parts and valuables from customer's cars. Mr. Yang, was a man who made fake banknotes..

programme.title: 蔣英實
programme.desc: The drama is the first 'historic science' drama that has been produced in Korea. This drama depicts the successful life story of the scientist Jang Youngsil that contributed to the development and accomplishment of Joseon's science during the 15th century. In particular, the drama emphasizes his accomplishment through showing the restrictions and difficulties he experienced due to his social class as a slave. Moreover, the drama aims to depict Jang Youngsil as the role model of 'Korea's youth of the 21st century' through displaying his scientific accomplishments. The drama also expects to stimulate scientific curiosity amongst audiences and help them easily understand the fundamental principles of science by utilizing various data and scientific videos.

programme.desc: In Onjeong Market, located in Onjeong, a town some distance away from Seoul, the area is buzzing with change as apartment complexes are built and plans for subway extensions and new town developments are announced. Across a single street stand a principled general hospital, Gongmyeongjeongdae Clinic, and traditional Korean clinic, Yangji Barun Clinic. The two families who run these places have been bitter enemies for years, bound by a long standing grudge from an incident in the past. programme.title: Trucking Hell 第2季
programme.desc: A 44-ton Artic straddling the central reservation of the M1 is a rush hour headache for Crouch Recovery Incident Manager Steve and one of the youngest Recovery Ops on the team, Pat. Down South, Lantern Recovery op Steve rescues a broken down 26-ton dustcart from a busy London street. Crouch Recovery op Jim gets drenched as he risks life and limb trying to get a broken-down tractor back to its farm – just a hundred yards away! And Lantern’s night shift recovery op Jason faces a battle to rescue an articulated lorry that’s crashed down a steep ditch off the A1.

programme.title: Trucking Hell 第2季
programme.desc: An overturned Gas tanker full of highly flammable propane mean trouble for Crouch Recovery Incident Manager Steve. Working with the fire service he must all his experience to keep his team out of danger. Meanwhile with very little room to manoeuvre Lantern recovery op Steve must rescue a 44-ton artic stuck in a ditch on a busy five lane roundabout. And Lantern Recovery Op Sean has thought on his feet to break into an abandoned truck.

programme.title: Trucking Hell 第2季
programme.desc: Crouch Recovery Op Jim and heavy mechanic Jack are faced with an increasingly complex recovery challenge. A foreign truck with dodgy suspension airbags and a catalogue of other problems makes towing it anywhere a real headache and a potential threat to other road users. Lantern Recovery op Sean is in a race against time to get a fully loaded dual tanker off a busy stretch of motorway. And recovery op Merrie has a nightmare when an unforeseeable problem leaves her stranded in a live lane of the motorway when towing a car transporter.

programme.title: Trucking Hell 第2季
programme.desc: A digger as fallen off the back of a lorry and rolled over on its side - blocking one side of a busy A road. Crouch recovery Incident Manager Steve must work out how to get the vehicle upright without being able to close the whole road – a tricky challenge indeed! Richard Crouch and recovery op Lee Brown have a hay bale of a time trying to get a valuable straw load on a broken-down trailer back safely to its owner. And Crouch recovery op Marta earns her daily bread rescuing a stricken van load of loaves.

programme.title: Trucking Hell 第2季
programme.desc: In this episode a 40-ton lorry rammed full of scrap metal overturns and spills its steel load across a major A road during rush hour, and Lantern recovery op Steve Knight is called to the scene. 25 tonnes of metal must be removed from the lorry before it can be lifted and with a damaged 5th wheel, it’s a job that will push Steve and his team to the limit. At Crouch HQ there’s excitement in the air as the team give trucking superfan Chris and his disabled daughter, the ride of his life by taking him to his wedding in a big orange truck. Late at night, recovery op Snod is called to the side of the M69 to recover two crashed cars. With one on its side with the hand brake off, he must take care righting it to make sure it doesn’t roll into the passing traffic. It’s particularly tough job for Snod as his friend was killed on the same stretch of road whilst recovering a vehicle.

programme.title: Fatal Engineering 第1季
programme.desc: High-speed loops, dizzying drops, and the rush of adrenaline—roller coasters are feats of physics and design. But when safety systems fail, lives hang in the balance. In this episode, Fatal Engineering explores some of the most chilling roller coaster accidents in history, analyzing how minute mechanical failures, operator mistakes, and ignored warning signs led to serious injuries and death. Discover what these tragedies taught us about engineering safety and the balance between thrill and risk.

programme.title: Ice Pilots NWT 第6季
programme.desc: It’s Buffalo’s busiest winter yet, and they roll out the C-46, TXW, to fly all the freight up the Mackenzie Valley. But when one of TXW’s engines catches fire, Buffalo scrambles to find a backup plane in time for Christmas deliveries. They look to their newly purchased Electra, XFC, to fill the void, but Adam, Chuck, Brian and Mikey discover it has a cracked windshield and cannot be flown safely. Joe, Brian and Cory fly to meet Rod in Red Deer to grab a replacement windshield. When they arrive, Joe first reveals his other plans—he wants the second Electra ZFE dug out of the snowbank where it’s been sitting for months and get it up and running so that it can replace XFC on the Valley run. Rod’s upset that he wasn’t given more notice, and unloads on Mikey about Joe’s reactionary management style. Back in Yellowknife, Buffalo’s newest rampie, Prefkar Mony, is a determined young pilot from India who’s got his eyes on flying Joe’s prize planes. But first he has to adjust to life in the Nort.

programme.title: Ice Pilots NWT 第6季
programme.desc: Chief Pilot AJ Decoste is flying up the Mackenzie Valley with Buffalo’s newest Electra, XFC, for the first time. Mechanic Cory Dodd is along for the ride to do some training as a Flight Engineer. They try to make their deliveries before a storm rolls in but when they land in Norman Wells, they are faced with gale force winds. When their takeoff is delayed by two incoming planes, AJ is forced to shut down and wait out the storm in Norman Wells. Later, on their approach to Tulita, they face even stronger winds gusting over 40 knots. Over in Hay River, things go from bad to worse when a warm weather system brings the threat of a rare ice storm. Two daily skeds arrive from Yellowknife and the rampies have to batten down the DC-3s in preparation for a long, rough night—the worst storm in fifty years. And the newest rampie, CJ Asaf, just can’t seem to fit in. Rampie Prefkar is tasked with training CJ on the Hay River delivery route, but Prefkar can’t handle CJ or his attitude.

programme.title: Fatal Engineering 第1季
programme.desc: Skyscrapers represent human ambition and engineering prowess—until gravity wins. This episode looks at the devastating collapse of tall buildings, revealing how hidden flaws, faulty materials, and inadequate planning can bring down even the mightiest towers. With insights from architects and engineers, we revisit landmark disasters that not only destroyed property but claimed lives and reshaped how we build upward in the modern world.

programme.title: Ice Pilots NWT 第6季
programme.desc: When Buffalo’s newest Electra, ZFE, lands in Yellowknife with only three functioning engines, mechanic Chuck Adams comes to the rescue to replace a brand-new $29,000 regulator on engine number three. It’s been slow for the airline and delivering a load of building supplies to the RCMP up in Ulukhaktok, NWT, might help keep Buffalo in the air. Spurred by a recent crash landing and two engine fires, an audit team from Transport Canada descends on Buffalo Airways. With their long and tumultuous history with Joe, they demand that Buffalo appoint a new “Accountable Executive” within 72 hours, or risk being shut down. But Joe isn’t about to hand over the keys to the kingdom—not even to Rod, his oldest son. Mikey worries that if they don’t meet the deadline, Buffalo Airways could become Buffalo Spare Parts. Transport Canada isn’t the only thing on Joe’s mind; it’s becoming apparent that Joe’s 16-year-old rescue dog, Sophie, is on her last legs. One morning Joe finds Sophie lying under a plane.

programme.title: Ice Pilots NWT 第6季
programme.desc: Buffalo Joe has been a captain on the daily sked for 34 years and his 70th birthday is next week. Joe might have to stop flying if he doesn’t pass his medical and that could spell the end of Buffalo. Before Joe leaves to undergo five days of medical tests at the Mayo Clinic in Phoenix, Arizona, he calls two rampies, Sam Storm and Jeff Tapper, into his office to greenlight their DC-3 checkflights. Both Jeff and Sam have slogged away for eight months waiting for this chance. But on flight day, Sam is sick to his stomach from eating bad eggs the night before. Sam is not about to let a bad egg beat him and he helps Jeff prep DC-3, LFR. Just before takeoff, nausea wins—Sam has no choice but to back out and there’s no telling when he’ll get another chance. Jeff, on the other hand, has to overcome the jitters that have haunted him ever since he was in a crash landing earlier in the year. Mikey, Rod and his family prepare to greet Joe with a birthday cake shaped like a DC-3. At the last minute.

programme.title: Sumatra's Last Tigers 第1季
programme.desc: While tiger populations all around the world are crashing, tiger numbers in a remote nature reserve in Sumatra, Indonesia are increasing. Here even man killers are being rehabilitated and released into the wild. The man behind this unique conservation project is Indonesian tycoon, Tomy Winata. Tomy’s ambitious plan now includes releasing a tiger born in captivity into the wild, will it survive and can the experiment transform conservation practices and save the Sumatran tiger.

programme.title: Fatal Engineering 第1季
programme.desc: Skyscrapers represent human ambition and engineering prowess—until gravity wins. This episode looks at the devastating collapse of tall buildings, revealing how hidden flaws, faulty materials, and inadequate planning can bring down even the mightiest towers. With insights from architects and engineers, we revisit landmark disasters that not only destroyed property but claimed lives and reshaped how we build upward in the modern world.

programme.title: Ice Pilots NWT 第6季
programme.desc: When Buffalo’s newest Electra, ZFE, lands in Yellowknife with only three functioning engines, mechanic Chuck Adams comes to the rescue to replace a brand-new $29,000 regulator on engine number three. It’s been slow for the airline and delivering a load of building supplies to the RCMP up in Ulukhaktok, NWT, might help keep Buffalo in the air. Spurred by a recent crash landing and two engine fires, an audit team from Transport Canada descends on Buffalo Airways. With their long and tumultuous history with Joe, they demand that Buffalo appoint a new “Accountable Executive” within 72 hours, or risk being shut down. But Joe isn’t about to hand over the keys to the kingdom—not even to Rod, his oldest son. Mikey worries that if they don’t meet the deadline, Buffalo Airways could become Buffalo Spare Parts. Transport Canada isn’t the only thing on Joe’s mind; it’s becoming apparent that Joe’s 16-year-old rescue dog, Sophie, is on her last legs. One morning Joe finds Sophie lying under a plane.

programme.title: Trucking Hell 第2季
programme.desc: This week a heavy rescue like no other – as father and son Dave and Adam Crouch team up to save a lorry transporting a train from sinking into soft ground. Crouch Recovery Op Jim must rescue a lorry from a ditch after the driver attempted an ill-advised three-point turn. And while Rory moves an antique fire engine for the boss, Fluff must get rid of a lorry load of stinking cheese.

programme.title: Trucking Hell 第2季
programme.desc: In this week's episode Simon must grapple with a juggernaut that has skidded off the M62 and down a steep bank, but when they finally manage to pull it back onto the carriageway, it starts leaking diesel. Jim battles to rescue a car transporter stuck in a muddy layby, and his new best buddy, rookie driver Warren, faces a tricky tractor unit recovery on the side of a dual carriageway. Meanwhile, Rory must deal with a mobile library that’s been the victim of a shocking arson attack, and Fluff finds himself in a quandary in a quarry – rescuing a broken-down tipper truck.

programme.title: Trucking Hell 第2季
programme.desc: A broken-down coach on a slip road of the motorway presents a major problem for Crouch recovery op Jon and Highways England. Recovery Op Marta and Tez work together to solve a serious weight issue on her trailer load. Lantern Recovery Op Scott attends a road collision to find a trailer too damaged to tow – with the sun going down, will he get off the highway before darkness falls.

programme.title: Trucking Hell 第2季
programme.desc: In this episode crane operator Nick, is called out to a very unusual job removing two old portable cabins from a recycling yard and replacing with new ones. But with each cabin weighing at least four tonnes and overhead electrical cables to negotiate this is a highly hazardous job. Seasoned recovery op Jim’s must rescue an abandoned Toyota from a live lane on the M1. Recovery op Rory visits a depot in Milton Keynes to recover an 8-ton tractor unit normally used to transport pizza. Meanwhile rescue driver Jon must tow a 44-ton bus the wrong way down a dual carriageway….

programme.title: Trucking Hell 第2季
programme.desc: In this week’s episode Recovery Op Jim is called to the scene of two crashed artics on the M1. But as Jim and his team begin to pull the truck and trailer apart, they discover the crash has split the hydraulic oil tank and it’s now leaking all over the road making the job a whole lot more complicated! Recovery Op Rory attends what looks like a simple job, but some hidden vandalism leaves him scratching his head and needing to improvise. Rookie wrecker driver Warren faces a day on the hard shoulder of the motorway trying to rescue some highly unusual vehicles - a potentially occupied prison van and a group of shark fishers.

programme.title: Ice Pilots NWT 第6季
programme.desc: Buffalo Joe has been a captain on the daily sked for 34 years and his 70th birthday is next week. Joe might have to stop flying if he doesn’t pass his medical and that could spell the end of Buffalo. Before Joe leaves to undergo five days of medical tests at the Mayo Clinic in Phoenix, Arizona, he calls two rampies, Sam Storm and Jeff Tapper, into his office to greenlight their DC-3 checkflights. Both Jeff and Sam have slogged away for eight months waiting for this chance. But on flight day, Sam is sick to his stomach from eating bad eggs the night before. Sam is not about to let a bad egg beat him and he helps Jeff prep DC-3, LFR. Just before takeoff, nausea wins—Sam has no choice but to back out and there’s no telling when he’ll get another chance. Jeff, on the other hand, has to overcome the jitters that have haunted him ever since he was in a crash landing earlier in the year. Mikey, Rod and his family prepare to greet Joe with a birthday cake shaped like a DC-3. At the last minute.

programme.desc: Cornish king crab is on the menu for Rick as he heads out of Newquay to catch and cook this tasty crustacean. Afterwards, he takes a trip inland to Bodmin Moor to meet Robin Hanbury Tenison, one of the 20th century's last great explorers. His farm is home to one of Cornwall's most ambitious rewilding projects, where Robin's son, Merlin, has recently introduced a pair of wild beavers who are doing their best to restore biodiversity in this corner of Cornwall.

學人沙龍
programme.desc: 在現代文明與教育體系中，我們長期推崇理性，強調邏輯、效率、客觀分析，將「正確答案」視為知識的核心。然而，人之所以為人，從來不只靠理性運作，情緒、感受、直覺，以及同理心來塑造出我們理解世界與他人的方式。當學校教育我們計算、辯論、判斷，卻較少教我們如何感受、表達、處理悲傷、憤怒、愛與失落，「情感教育」是否一直被排除在主流教育之外？. 主持：. 米哈(作家). 黃仲遠(註冊組織心理學家). 蕭欣浩(大學講師). 嘉賓：. 曾奕文(音樂學院副教授). #理性#邏輯#情緒#表達#情感的教育#學人沙龍.

programme.title: 醫生與你 - 醫學．人 2026
programme.sub-title: #4 人人識急救 - 蕭粵中醫生
programme.desc: 『人人識急救』是蕭粵中醫生一直追求的願景。. 蕭粵中：「其實有些簡單的急救，並不是很困難，所以希望能夠做到一件事，就是人人識急救，變成人人可以幫到其他人。」. 蕭粵中醫生在急症室工作逾30年，2024年獲得醫管局傑出員工。由他領導的急救科訓練中心，多年來培養超過十萬名專業人士及普羅大眾。為了普及急救知識，蕭醫生還粉墨登場、扮鬼扮馬，自資拍攝多條教育短片。. 他加入醫管局香港境外緊急應變行動計劃支援隊多年，曾於新冠疫情時參與港人從武漢撤離的行動，以及2025年緬甸7.7級地震後的救災行動。. 蕭醫生一直堅持兩個「誠」字：對人真誠；亦對工作充滿熱誠。在急症室盡力拯救生命之餘，在醫院以外亦推動人人識急救。. 主持：黃婉曼. 嘉賓：蕭粵中醫生(急症科醫生、律敦治及鄧肇堅醫院急症科部門主管).

programme.title: 棋士
programme.sub-title: 第十九集：金夏生被一隻耳朵殺害
programme.desc: 夏生和一隻耳準備去媽祖廟與崔業匯合時，夏生發現後視鏡吊墜竟是自己送給崔業的護身符，急忙叫停想打電話聯絡，卻忘帶手機。一隻耳下車坦言已綁架崔業妻兒，夏生試圖制服他，兩人扭打，夏生最終被飛馳貨車撞倒，一隻耳拿錘猛砸其頭致死，夏生死去瞬間，醫院裏的夏雨甦醒。同時崔偉向警局指認弟弟崔業是關鍵人物，因迴避原則只能回家待命，深夜在醫院靠嘉雯肩上痛哭。一隻耳載夏生屍體來見崔業，崔業發現夏生已死，與一隻耳大打出手。一隻耳承認殺夏生並綁架淑華母子，要求後續交易由他收錢。崔業埋葬夏生時意外發現他手臂刻有關鍵訊息，第二天假借打電話向崔偉傳遞訊息。此時，被綁在廢棄隧道中的淑華和炎高醒了過來.

programme.title: 大港腳闖中超
programme.desc: 為了挑戰自己，不少香港職業球員都會爭取加入中超球會，到更大的比賽場尋突破、展抱負。. 擁有中德血統的周緣德(Oliver Gerbig)自小喜歡足球，24歲加入港超球會傑志，更入選中國香港隊出戰亞洲盃，亦因而被河南足球俱樂部賞識，邀請加入，在2024年正式成為中超球員。. 球場愈大，挑戰也愈大。. 隻身來到河南鄭州，面對陌生的環境，周緣德會如何面對，用實力來證明自己.

programme.title: 童真無國界
programme.desc: Keung is looking forward to Saturday, which is a big day for him. He’s going to the Animation-comic Festival for the first time!. As early as Monday, he’s anxious about it. He doesn’t care for anything, except the coming Saturday. But all of a sudden, he finds himself living the same day repeatedly. Every morning he wakes up, it is Monday. From puzzling to playing video games happily, to getting bored, to doing his homework … Miraculously, Keung wakes up one morning and finds it is Tuesday. . Days repeat over and over again, and with much hassle, he finally makes it to Friday. He realises life can be interesting and meaningful as long as he lives every day well. Will Keung be able to go to the animation-comic festival at last.

programme.title: 《科學 ∙ 創未來3》
programme.desc: How did scientists embark on their journeys? What challenges and doubts have they come across along the way? These experiences are undoubtedly invaluable to future scientists aspiring to undertake scientific research. . The four laureates this year, Professor Xing XU, Professor Zhonghe ZHOU, Professor Xi DAI and Professor Hong DING, specially attended the talk “Dialogue with the Youth” for young people. They had close exchanges with Hong Kong secondary students from different schools, during which they delved into topics from palaeontology to forefront condensed matter physics, and shared their journeys of growth. The talk brought the Prize Week to a perfect close.

programme.title: 香港故事:尾巴會說話(英文版)
programme.desc: Dogs need to work too!. Happy, Cindy’s little poodle, is more than just a beloved pet—she’s a partner in a mission of care. A year ago, Happy passed the rigorous interview to become a therapy dog. Since then, Cindy and Happy have trained side by side, dreaming of joining the therapy dog team to bring comfort and healing to those in need. More than a decade ago, Debbie Ngai was working as a social worker with teenagers. One day, she took a group of young people to volunteer at a dog shelter. To her surprise, she noticed how the presence of dogs softened the youth—making them more patient, more tolerant. That experience changed her life. Debbie went on to become a certified animal assisted therapist, and with her own dog, Pearl, she began helping children and teens struggling with emotional challenges or special learning needs. Through the simple yet powerful bond between human and dog, she witnessed hearts unlocking and lives being transformed. But becoming a therapy dog is no easy task. The path involves interviews, classes, internships, and exams. Over the past year, Cindy and Happy have thrown themselves into preparation, working diligently toward their goal. In the end, will they succeed.

programme.title: 奇趣100 FUN
programme.desc: 尋古大師在星空下睡覺，但他很想念自己舒適的床。於是帶我們展開旅程，探索這件不可或缺的家具…床的歷史。一個人睡在自己的小床並並非自古以來的慣例，在中世紀，人們不但喜歡擠在同一張床來取暖，甚至跟陌生人同床也不介意！床不僅用來睡覺，還可以吃飯、學習，甚至像法國國王路易十四那樣！就在路易十四忙碌之際，尋古大師突然到訪，帶來一場驚喜.

programme.title: 奇趣100 FUN
programme.desc: 尋古大師弄丟了他的鎖匙，於是他去拜訪了各式各樣的發明家和工匠，探索鑰匙的歷史。從埃及人使用的鉤子，到羅馬人的鑰匙圈，可謂應有盡有。這趟旅程意外引發了一場求婚情景，尋古大師必須不惜一切代價趁機逃脫，穿越回到現代。回到現代，他發現鎖匙將被電子鎖系統取代而永遠消失.

programme.title: 動物童萌
programme.desc: 牠們或許不是最有魅力的小動物，但每隻都有自己獨有的吸引力，包括騎著媽媽的袋獾寶寶、漫遊非洲草原的鬣狗及在泥土中嗅探的農場小豬，印證了外表不重要，媽媽的愛才最重要.

programme.title: 傷健同行好僱事
programme.desc: Two large local enterprises providing public services have been actively hiring individuals with disabilities in recent years, striving to create an inclusive workplace environment. . A long-established bus company offers job positions for people with disabilities in various departments. For example, the catering service and gardening job are primarily managed by employess with mild intellectual disabilities, while deaf employees can also be seen in the lost and found and cash handling teams. The bus company has collaborated closely with social enterprises and special training schools over the years to create and provide diverse job opportunities for individuals with disabilities. . The Hong Chi Association, a social welfare organization that has been providing various vocational training programs for individuals with mild intellectual disabilities for fifty years, has recently collaborated with the bus company in various forms, becoming an important driving force in employment for people with disabilities. . The gas company, established for over 160 years, has extensive experience in employing individuals with disabilities, including several wheelchair users in its customer service department. Many facilities in the gas company's headquarters have been thoughtfully designed to provide an accessible working environment for wheelchair users.

照亮你
programme.sub-title: 第六集: 徐來竟然是訓犬專家？
programme.desc: 霍宗岩藉工作機會接觸靳時川，提醒他要遠離徐來。徐來為老舊社區火災一事做專題報道，遇上探望社區孤寡老人的靳。靳邀請徐吃飯，席間明確拒絕她的愛意，而徐則借醉吻了他。靳時川被任命兼任地震救援隊隊長，組建搜救犬救援隊，卻在搜救犬基地碰上擔任訓犬專家的徐來.

programme.title: 照亮你
programme.sub-title: 第七集: 原來你仍然是怕黑
programme.desc: 徐來對靳時川故作冷淡，專心指導隊員訓犬。靳約徐晚上討論工作安排，開會期間忽然打雷並停電，徐驚慌地靠向靳，這才得知她因過往的經歷害怕打雷及黑暗環境，靳輕聲安撫她。救援隊新兵張洋挑戰靳時川徒手爬繩，被靳擊敗.

演藝盛薈．開放舞台：拉威爾誕生150週年紀念音樂會
programme.sub-title: 拉威爾誕生150週年紀念音樂會
programme.desc: 二十世紀最重要作曲家之一：拉威爾（Maurice Ravel），其音樂豐富而細膩，情感真摯而尖銳。為慶祝拉威爾誕辰 150 週年，一眾本地優秀藝術家舉辦了一場聚焦於他的藝術歌曲和室樂作品的音樂會，以展示他對音樂世界的深遠影響。音樂會片段由非凡美樂提供。. 藝術總監：盧景文. 鋼琴：張緯晴. 鋼琴二重奏：娉婷鋼琴二重奏. 豎琴：譚懷理. 單簧管：區淑儀. 長笛：梁凱淇. 羅曼四重奏. 女中音：連皓忻. 男中音：林國浩. 鋼琴：魏安娜.

programme.title: 港樂 • 講樂
programme.desc: 一個嘉賓不足夠？那就不如打孖上。今個星期我們請來黃淑蔓(Feanna)及應智越(細貓)一起上來做嘉賓，原來他們私底下已經相識多年，老友鬼鬼。他們今次都各自帶來多首作品外，更分享對對方的感覺，向大家透露未來工作大計。想欣賞他們的新歌，就要留意今集節目！. 主持：阮頌陽、周卓盈. 歌曲：. -《雙魚座》(周卓盈). -《梗頸四》(黃淑蔓). -《未至於》(黃淑蔓). -《i 人情歌》(應智越).

programme.title: 守藝薪傳
programme.desc: 粵劇，一門融合南北藝術精粹嘅傳統表演藝術。由明清時期繁華的廣州，到香港戰後蓬勃發展，粵劇一直演變創新，成為人類非物質文化遺產。芳雪瑩由中學英文老師變成粵劇導師，放棄教職，全心全意培育後進。其徒弟張雅泳更五歲開始習藝，十歲經已成為文武生，多年來獲獎無數之餘，亦開始把粵劇的火苗傳承下去。師徒兩代人，用粵劇藝術感染年輕一代，開創屬於香港粵劇的未來.

programme.title: 中醫藥旗艦展新篇 (普通話版)
港樂 • 講樂
programme.desc: 如果覺得生活充滿枷鎖、透不過氣，那就讓本地樂隊—Locksmiths 開鎖佬，用音樂幫你打開心鎖，釋放壓力！. 五位「開鎖佬」成員，大雄、Tom、Eric、阿東同 Harry，性格大不同。不知在音樂創作過程中，成員又如何溝通，激發靈感？想知道他們有什麼新動向，就要留意今集節目！. 主持. 阮頌陽. 歌曲：. -《我們都是這樣沒有長大的》. -《煩惱事九成都不會發生》. #港樂講樂#Locksmiths#開鎖佬#大雄#Tom#Eric#阿東#Harry#本地樂隊#搖滾音樂#我們都是這樣沒有長大的#煩惱事九成都不會發生#阮頌陽.

programme.desc: 崔偉將崔業名字寫上警局白板，所有線索瞬間串聯，因聯絡不上嫌犯及其家屬，他先到崔業家，從座機發現淑華和炎高被綁架的訊息。同時崔業帶一隻耳到火車站附近交代後續計劃，確認後表示先找易叔談談。崔偉在樹林發現夏生屍體，從手臂刻的「930」線索展開全市搜查，並懷疑另有他人劫持淑華母子、殺夏生。小丁查到劉慶隆換貨單，崔偉將目標鎖定放貸人易佛生。傍晚崔業和一隻耳在路邊吃鴨腿飯，一隻耳講述自己過去，飯後崔業說明天等易叔籌錢，一隻耳卻要他陪逛街。第二天崔偉接夏雨甦醒電話趕往醫院，夏雨聞夏生死訊痛不欲生，崔偉想起醫院擦肩而過的一隻耳，決定打電話給崔業讓他配合先救人.

programme.sub-title: The Young and Prodigious T.S. Spivet
programme.desc: Ten-year-old T.S. Spivet lives on a remote ranch in Montana. A gifted child with a passion for science, he has invented a perpetual motion machine, for which he has been awarded the prestigious Baird Prize by the Smithsonian Institution in Washington. He leaves a note for his family and hops a freight train to make his way across the United States and receive his prize.

programme.title: 大港腳闖中超
programme.desc: 為了挑戰自己，不少香港職業球員都會爭取加入中超球會，到更大的比賽場尋突破、展抱負。. 擁有中德血統的周緣德(Oliver Gerbig)自小喜歡足球，24歲加入港超球會傑志，更入選中國香港隊出戰亞洲盃，亦因而被河南足球俱樂部賞識，邀請加入，在2024年正式成為中超球員。. 球場愈大，挑戰也愈大。. 隻身來到河南鄭州，面對陌生的環境，周緣德會如何面對，用實力來證明自己.

programme.title: 鏗鏘集
programme.desc: Behind the grand event of the Special Olympics, there is a group of unsung heroes silently supporting! Coaches, parents, and teachers dedicate their time, money, and emotions to accompany athletes with disabilities onto the international stage. The Hong Kong government has increased resource investment to optimise the training system, enabling more individuals with disabilities to engage in sports.

programme.title: 傷健同行好僱事
programme.desc: Two large local enterprises providing public services have been actively hiring individuals with disabilities in recent years, striving to create an inclusive workplace environment. . A long-established bus company offers job positions for people with disabilities in various departments. For example, the catering service and gardening job are primarily managed by employess with mild intellectual disabilities, while deaf employees can also be seen in the lost and found and cash handling teams. The bus company has collaborated closely with social enterprises and special training schools over the years to create and provide diverse job opportunities for individuals with disabilities. . The Hong Chi Association, a social welfare organization that has been providing various vocational training programs for individuals with mild intellectual disabilities for fifty years, has recently collaborated with the bus company in various forms, becoming an important driving force in employment for people with disabilities. . The gas company, established for over 160 years, has extensive experience in employing individuals with disabilities, including several wheelchair users in its customer service department. Many facilities in the gas company's headquarters have been thoughtfully designed to provide an accessible working environment for wheelchair users.

programme.title: 醫生與你
programme.desc: 正所謂「夏日炎炎」，香港夏天又熱又濕，身體容易因為高溫、出汗、冷氣溫差，以及蚊蟲活躍等因素，引發熱傷害、皮膚感染，甚至呼吸道等健康問題。事實上，夏季常見的不適，往往與生活習慣密切相關，例如長時間戶外活動又補水不足、冷氣房內外溫差過大、流汗後皮膚未有及時保持乾爽等，這些問題雖然常見，但不少人會因為誤解而延誤處理。. 本集請來家庭醫學專科醫生，替我們拆解夏季常見的健康迷思，以及講解應對良策。. 主持：蔡雪瑩、胡志遠醫生. 嘉賓：謝雪兒醫生(香港中文大學醫學院賽馬會公共衛生及基層醫療學院名譽臨床助理教授).

programme.title: 香港故事 - 聲音導航
programme.desc: 琴弦的振動，透過木結他琴身的共鳴放大聲音，結他面板的木材對音色影響非常重要。古典結他演奏家羅翔(Steven Law)製造了第一支全使用香港本地木材製作的木結他，奏出本地獨特的結他音色。熱愛製作及復修結他的Steven吸引不同人士「入坑」自製手工結他，其中一位是結他收藏家大肥(崔立德）。Steven 歴年來替大肥維修過無數支結他，二人惺惺相識，成為朋友。復修後的結他帶來美好音色和回憶，原來古典結他可以獨奏之餘，亦在人與人之間產生層層回聲.

programme.title: 歡迎來到麥樂村
programme.sub-title: 第六集: 初到非洲生活的挑戰
programme.desc: 眾人出發桑納的麥樂村，眾人發現村裏環境很好，還未意識到快面對的問題。馬嘉誤用了珍貴的食水洗面，被江大喬責備。中國醫療隊支援的卡塞醫院，屬於是非洲重症病患的集中地，但醫院不只設備舊，連醫護人員都少得可憐，大部份醫生都是類似村醫的醫生在做輔助.

31看世界 - 守護天堂
programme.desc: 潘塔納爾濕地是巴西最大的濕地，長久以來一直都是美洲豹、爬行動物、貘以及多種鳥類的庇護所。除了於2020年遭受極乾旱的氣候及大火蹂躪，當地亦面對農業和畜牧業發展帶來的威脅。為了拯救這個獨特的生態系統以及其各個標誌性的物種，擴展保護區已是刻不容緩。. 雙語廣播： 粵語/英語 (電視版 及 網上版) . 播出時間： (首播) 2025年7月29日 星期二 晚上10時. . Brazil’s largest wetland has long been a sanctuary for jaguars, reptiles, tapirs and many bird species. Plagued by exceptional drought and wildfires in 2020, it is also suffering from the development of agriculture and livestock farming. To save this unique ecosystem and its iconic species, protected areas are becoming a matter of urgency. . Bilingual: Cantonese / English (TV version & Web version) . Time: (First run) 2025.07.29 Tue 10pm.

programme.desc: 《AI 在身邊》. 曾幾何時，人工智能（AI）只存在電影幻想之中；如今，AI 已學會像人類般思考、學習與解決問題。初創公司負責人Bono全面擁抱AI，AI是他的工作夥伴、秘書、會計同事；是跑步教練、營養師、甚至用來跟另一半溝通；然而，在「無所不能」的背後，是隱藏著私隱隱憂、人際隔閡，以及「有圖無真相」真偽難分的時代。傳統餐飲行業面對人手短缺，有 Cafe 引入咖啡沖煮機械人;電訊服務供應商運用AI維持網絡穩定，甚至迪士尼由後勤保養到前線表演都應用AI。當AI漸漸與香港人的生活接軌，我們迎來的是無所不能的進化，還是難以預測的挑戰.

programme.title: 狂飆

programme.desc: Gordon Ramsay到了葡萄牙的海岸區，這裡的菜式崇尚簡單質樸，正好展示其生活態度。Gordon於廣闊的牧場追趕黑豬餵飼，下海在巨浪衝擊的岩石崖壁採摘鵝頸藤壺，又坐上漁船駛進公海捕獲標誌性的沙甸。今集，他要挑戰當地名廚Kiko Martins，為納扎雷市長預備一頓盛宴。. 雙語廣播： 粵語/英語 (電視版) 播出時間： (首播) 2024年12月24日 星期二晚，10時30分 Chef Ramsay explores the rugged landscape of Portugal, where the simple way of life is evident in the country’s incredible cuisine. Gordon will chase black pigs across a farm to feed them, brave giant waves for barnacles that cling to the rocky coastline and sail the open seas to fish for iconic sardines. He’ll need to roll up his sleeves and bring his A-game in order to beat local chef, Kiko Martins, in an epic feast for the Mayor of Nazaré. . programme.title: 無所畏懼 (第一季)
programme.sub-title: 第三十集：羅英子和邱華接謀殺案
programme.desc: 羅英子和邱華走訪了馬麗麗前夫許建設的公司，發現公司已經關門，通過保安得知他仍有幾套房子，完全具備償還受害人賠款的能力，然而他堅決不肯認罪，羅英子覺得許建設可能是無辜的，但邱華認為事件沒這麼簡單。及後，羅英子和邱華會見許建設，對方一口咬定自己是無辜的.

programme.title: 無所畏懼 (第一季)
programme.sub-title: 第三十一集：羅母被劉母害得病發入院
programme.desc: 羅英子和邱華向許建設提議辯護分兩步走，一步做無罪辯護，另一步做輕罪辯護。許建設聽後堅決否認殺過人，要求必須做無罪辯護，然而控方新證據的提交令官司情況對他非常不利。此時，羅英子突然收到羅父的來電指羅母被劉母氣得病發入院，生命垂危，羅英子急忙趕回家.

programme.title: 奀菇菇搞搞震 2
programme.desc: 秀珍妹記得自己還是菇BB的時候，曾經非常喜歡在彈彈藤上保持平衡。但事實上，她從來沒有真正學會過，總是不斷跌下來，心裡越來越覺得沮喪。最終，菇長老決定挺身而出，親自教秀珍妹如何像高手般在彈彈藤上平衡.

programme.title: 小農夫大作物 新一彈
programme.desc: 今次我們在深川市學習如何種植時令蘋果。種植蘋果非常困難，需要逐個套上袋子、拆下、並轉向另一面。蘋果農烹調的蘋果菜式給我們留下深刻印象。今集也請來男子組合NORD成員島太星做嘉賓.

programme.title: 香港故事: 由AI開始
programme.desc: 《AI 在身邊》. 曾幾何時，人工智能（AI）只存在電影幻想之中；如今，AI 已學會像人類般思考、學習與解決問題。初創公司負責人Bono全面擁抱AI，AI是他的工作夥伴、秘書、會計同事；是跑步教練、營養師、甚至用來跟另一半溝通；然而，在「無所不能」的背後，是隱藏著私隱隱憂、人際隔閡，以及「有圖無真相」真偽難分的時代。傳統餐飲行業面對人手短缺，有 Cafe 引入咖啡沖煮機械人;電訊服務供應商運用AI維持網絡穩定，甚至迪士尼由後勤保養到前線表演都應用AI。當AI漸漸與香港人的生活接軌，我們迎來的是無所不能的進化，還是難以預測的挑戰.

programme.title: 老家伙
programme.sub-title: 第二十六集：妻子張桂榮逼陳新城學做飯
programme.desc: 一大清早，太太張桂榮就逼丈夫陳新城起床，又叫他學做飯。在太太幾十年的悉心照料下，陳新城是一輩子都沒做過飯，自然手忙腳亂，把廚房弄得一片狼藉。陳新城失去耐心，堅決不再學，無論張桂榮怎麼說，都不再戴上圍裙，張桂榮生氣離開.

programme.desc: 馬嘉病倒，去找當地的迪斯馬斯醫生，是對方認為馬嘉的身體狀況問題不大，拒絕給他輸液。馬嘉用了自帶的備用針劑紮針輸液，被迪斯馬斯撞見，十分生氣。院長找到江大喬，希望他來出面處理這件事。馬嘉覺得自己沒有錯，江大喬認為馬嘉不尊重值班醫生，總是在製造麻煩.

programme.title: 31看世界 - Gordon Ramsay 瘋味之旅 3
programme.desc: Gordon Ramsay到了葡萄牙的海岸區，這裡的菜式崇尚簡單質樸，正好展示其生活態度。Gordon於廣闊的牧場追趕黑豬餵飼，下海在巨浪衝擊的岩石崖壁採摘鵝頸藤壺，又坐上漁船駛進公海捕獲標誌性的沙甸。今集，他要挑戰當地名廚Kiko Martins，為納扎雷市長預備一頓盛宴。. 雙語廣播： 粵語/英語 (電視版) 播出時間： (首播) 2024年12月24日 星期二晚，10時30分 Chef Ramsay explores the rugged landscape of Portugal, where the simple way of life is evident in the country’s incredible cuisine. Gordon will chase black pigs across a farm to feed them, brave giant waves for barnacles that cling to the rocky coastline and sail the open seas to fish for iconic sardines. He’ll need to roll up his sleeves and bring his A-game in order to beat local chef, Kiko Martins, in an epic feast for the Mayor of Nazaré. . programme.desc: 劉銘父母找到律師所，要求羅英子對劉銘撤訴，但這次羅英子不再心軟決絕離開，劉銘父母滿臉絕望。開庭前，羅英子和邱華會見許建設，但許建設比起之前表現得很是反常，期後更要求撤換律師。經了解後，她們才知道原來是馬麗麗在背後唆擺，目的就是要讓許建設被判無期徒刑.

programme.title: 無所畏懼 (第一季)
programme.sub-title: 第三十七集：温莉處心積慮接近丁啟偉
programme.desc: 温莉通過孫華鼎的介紹來到搏適集團找到老總丁兆光談生意，乘機接近丁總的兒子小丁。温莉知道小丁喜歡電影，便投其所好告知他自己也是個電影迷，兩人熟落起來。此時，馬麗麗走來律師所，表示要以夏舒曾收下了她轉交給許建設信件的視頻，告她們三人助自己和許建設串供.

programme.title: 政正關你事 - 官員講話摘要
香港故事:尾巴會說話(英文版)
programme.desc: The Magic of Wings . Every parrot has a character of its own. The African grey named Baba Chicken is a gifted mimic and a born troublemaker. You always know she’s there when she calls out her signature lines: “Why do you keep looking at me?”, “Pork Chop Bun,” and “Walnut.” She loves to talk, and she loves to eat even more. . When Yoyo was sixteen, Baba Chicken entered her life. The family welcomed the new member with excitement—everyone except Yoyo, who felt as if an uninvited guest had moved in. Over nine years of living together, everything slowly changed. Doubt turned into affection. As Yoyo cared for Baba Chicken, Baba Chicken was also by her side, growing with her. The parrot’s wit and playful spirit began to inspire Yoyo’s creative work and her dreams for the future. Shan Shan’s story unfolds differently. She was drawn to the charm of lovebirds — their gentle calls and soft pastel feathers. Lovebirds are known to live in pairs, but Shan Shan never expected her own parrots to become a couple. Then one day in 2023, they built a nest and welcomed six little ones. The moment filled her with deep and lasting joy. No matter what personalities these parrots display, both Yoyo and Shan Shan treasure every simple moment they share with them. Their days are never silent, often noisy, sometimes chaotic — but always filled with love and companionship beyond measure. This is the magic of wings.

programme.title: 照亮你
programme.sub-title: 第八集: 風雨中的搜索行動
programme.desc: 徐來在尋找失蹤的搜救犬時不慎受傷，靳時川在風雨中找到她並將她送往醫院。徐來發燒住院，霍宗岩探望她，徐卻要霍幫她逃出醫院返搜救犬基地。靳在基地入口碰到二人，談話間徐點破了靳在吃醋。徐來拿藥油給靳時川，卻在靳的房間外聽到他跟隊員表示自己跟徐只是普通同事.

programme.title: 照亮你
programme.sub-title: 第九集: 搜救犬平安為救靳時川受傷
programme.desc: 徐來不吃晚飯在房間內生氣，霍宗岩來探望她，二人吃飯聊天。靳時川帶親自煮的麵找徐來，竟碰到霍、徐二人，吃醋離開。徐回房間見到那碗麵，頓時心頭一暖。搜救犬救援隊到沙灘邊嬉戲，遇上有人溺水，靳上前拯救卻陷險境，搜救犬平安幫靳脫險但受傷，令靳自責不已.

programme.title: 政正關你事 - 官員講話摘要
演藝盛薈：約翰紐邁亞的芭蕾舞劇 《請賜我們平安》
programme.sub-title: 約翰紐邁亞的芭蕾舞劇 《請賜我們平安》
programme.desc: 國際著名編舞家約翰‧紐邁亞，為漢堡芭蕾舞團創作了芭蕾舞劇《請賜我們平安》。在紐邁亞擔任漢堡芭蕾舞團藝術總監的第50個演出季當中，他視這次創作是一個難能可貴的機會。他聯同莫斯科大劇院芭蕾舞團及巴黎歌劇院，創作了一部以巴赫的《B小調彌撒曲》為主題的芭蕾舞劇。這是一場賞心悅目的精彩表演。. 播放頻道： 港台電視31 播出時間： (首播) 2025年7月26日 星期六 下午3時30分 . John Neumeier created one of his most popular ballets for the Hamburg Ballet: “Dona Nobis Pacem” - “Give Us Peace”. In his 50th season as artistic director, he sees this creation as a great opportunity. It would be inconceivable for him to create a ballet with the Mass in B minor with another company such as the Bolshoi Theater Ballet or the Paris Opera. It was truly a stunning performance!. Channel: RTHK 31 Time: (First Run) 2025.7.26 SAT 3:30pm.

programme.title: 守藝薪傳：名家導讀
programme.desc: 本集守藝薪傳名家導賞版，麥勁生教授將介紹中國傳統文化中的舞火龍和客家貔貅。. 舞火龍源自漢代傳統儀式，現於香港大坑和薄扶林村延續。蕭昆崙是薄扶林村的火龍守護者，六十年來，他用竹篾和香火編織火龍，對這項藝術的熱愛不減。他的兒子蕭震南承襲了父親的熱情，兩人攜手開辦工作坊，教授製作迷你火龍的技巧，讓這項傳統在現代社會中重獲新生。. 客家貔貅則是香港傳統文化的一個鮮為人知的故事。資深傳承人鍾浩聲將南鷹爪門白鶴派融入貔貅表演，成立香港獅藝舘，致力推廣客家文化。他的兒子作為第七代傳人，繼續傳承這三百年的藝術，見證香港文化的生命力.

programme.title: 港樂 • 講樂
programme.desc: 如果覺得生活充滿枷鎖、透不過氣，那就讓本地樂隊—Locksmiths 開鎖佬，用音樂幫你打開心鎖，釋放壓力！. 五位「開鎖佬」成員，大雄、Tom、Eric、阿東同 Harry，性格大不同。不知在音樂創作過程中，成員又如何溝通，激發靈感？想知道他們有什麼新動向，就要留意今集節目！. 主持. 阮頌陽. 歌曲：. -《我們都是這樣沒有長大的》. -《煩惱事九成都不會發生》. #港樂講樂#Locksmiths#開鎖佬#大雄#Tom#Eric#阿東#Harry#本地樂隊#搖滾音樂#我們都是這樣沒有長大的#煩惱事九成都不會發生#阮頌陽.

programme.title: 醫生與你 - 醫學．人 2026
programme.sub-title: #5 聽得見希望 - 唐志輝教授
programme.desc: 唐志輝醫生為香港中文大學耳鼻咽喉-頭頸外科學系臨床教授。他專攻耳外科、耳神經外科，以及顱底外科的領域，致力研究耳內窺鏡手術方面的新技術。2008 年，他帶領團隊成功為三名弱聽患者安裝「全植入助聽器」，成為亞洲首例。他又經常將人工耳蝸手術經驗分享至其他地區。他透露自己每次完成手術後，都會自我檢視成果，追求每次都做到「100＋」。. 除了臨床工作，唐教授亦投入培訓及公益工作。2003年，他連同幾位耳鼻喉科醫生及教育工作者，創立「耳聽心言基金」，在香港及內地推動聽力及言語障礙支援。廿幾年，他與團隊定期到內地，提供義務醫療服務。他形容做醫生每每最窩心的時刻，就是聽見病人經治療後「重拾希望」的故事。. 主持：黃婉曼. 嘉賓：唐志輝醫生（香港中文大學醫學院耳鼻咽喉-頭頸外科學系教授.

programme.title: 周末大電影：阿郎的故事
programme.desc: 阿郎(周潤發飾)年青時為一名出色的電單車賽車手，生性風流不覊，後因非法賽車而入獄。阿郎出獄後一直父兼母職，靠當工地司機撫養波仔(黃坤玄飾)，兩人相依為命。十年過去，波波(張艾嘉飾)回港工作重遇郎，並得悉波仔就是當年自己誤以為夭折了的兒子.

programme.title: 政正關你事 - 2025/26學年「心繫家國」聯校國民教育活動巡禮
國寶時刻
programme.desc: 魯國大玉璧屬於戰國時期，出土於山東曲阜的魯國故城，直徑32.8厘米，孔徑11.6厘米，為迄今最大之戰國玉璧。玉璧兩面紋飾相同，分內中外三層，刻有龍紋、谷紋等精細圖案，紋理佈局緊湊勻稱，工藝精湛。玉璧自古為祭祀天地之禮器，承載「天圓地方」之觀念，漢代更以玉璧陪葬祈求不朽，反映中華數千年崇玉文化.

programme.title: 國寶時刻
programme.desc: 《坤輿萬國全圖》繪製於明朝萬曆三十年（1602年），由傳教士利瑪竇與士大夫李之藻合作完成，是中國首幅中文世界地圖。圖中以中國為世界的中央，收錄五大洲、四大洋及天文地理知識的附圖，並融入中西繪圖技法。地圖旁註文豐富，記載各地風物與奇聞，展現明代先人對世界的探索與求知精神。「坤輿」意思為大地，此圖見證中華文明兼容並蓄的胸襟，是東西方文化交流的珍貴見證.

programme.title: 國寶時刻
programme.desc: 曾侯乙編鐘在1978年出土於湖北隨縣，為戰國早期諸侯——曾侯乙的陪葬品，三層八組一共65件的編鐘，懸掛在七米長的曲尺形鐘架上，總重逾5噸，是迄今規模最大、保存最完好的青銅樂器。編鐘採用合瓦形結構，一鐘雙音，音域橫跨五個半八度，並有3755字銘文記錄樂理知識，猶如一部青銅版的戰國音樂百科全書。它不僅是音樂史上的奇蹟，更體現了中國「天地人和」的哲學思想.

programme.title: 國寶時刻
programme.sub-title: 人物御龍帛畫、人物龍鳳帛畫
programme.desc: 戰國「人物龍鳳帛畫」與「人物御龍帛畫」分別於1949年及1973年出土於湖南長沙子彈庫楚墓，為中國現存最早之帛畫實物，被視為工筆繪畫之源頭。兩畫以絲帛為載體，筆墨精妙，「人物龍鳳帛畫」描繪女子合掌祈願、鳳鳥導引.

programme.title: 國寶時刻
programme.desc: 「太陽神鳥金飾」在2001年出土於四川成都金沙遺址，屬商周時期金器，直徑12.5厘米，厚度僅0.2毫米，含金量高達94.2%。「太陽神鳥」分內外兩層，內層為十二道弧形齒狀光芒構成的圓形，作順時針旋轉；外層則有四隻逆時針飛翔的神鳥，展現古蜀人對太陽與曆法的崇拜。圖案動靜相生，反映農耕文明對日月節律的掌握。此金飾現為「中國文化遺產標誌」，象徵中華文明對天地宇宙的永恆探索.

programme.title: 國寶時刻
programme.sub-title: 琺華彩貼金應龍紋梅瓶
programme.desc: 琺華彩貼金應龍紋梅瓶出土於南海明代深海裏的沉船，屬明正德年間景德鎮民窯精品。瓶身紋飾精妙，集瀝粉、鏤空、貼金、彩繪等工藝於一身，展現明代中期的高超製瓷水準。此瓶是當時為海外市場高端訂製的產品，見證「隆慶開關」政令之後，明代海外貿易蓬勃發展，亦是海上絲綢之路文明交流的重要物證，現藏於中國（海南）南海博物館.

programme.title: 國寶時刻
programme.desc: 孔子徒人圖漆衣鏡出土於南昌西漢海昏侯墓，屬於劉賀的陪葬品，鏡背繪有孔子及其弟子顏回、子贛、子路、堂駘子羽、子夏等人畫像與傳記，為目前所見最早之孔子像。衣鏡分為鏡掩、青銅鏡、鏡框三部分，飾有神獸、仙人及東王公、西王母等圖案。此鏡反映西漢獨尊儒術之社會風尚，亦印證《論語》在西漢時期的傳授學習，是儒家文化傳承的重要見證.

programme.title: 國寶時刻
programme.desc: 亞醜鉞出土於山東省青州市蘇埠屯1號大墓，該墓呈亞字形，有四條墓道，是殷墟商王陵外規格最高的商代墓葬。鉞身刻有「亞醜」二字，專家推測「亞醜」為殷商王族的族徽。亞醜家族的首領曾駐守青州，死後以王族規格下葬。亞醜鉞見證晚商時期商王朝向東方擴張、與東夷族逐步交融的歷史。中國歷史進程中，「鉞」最初為一種武器，乃王權及軍事指揮權之象徵；及至青銅時代，青銅鉞面世，成為商代的重要禮儀器物.

廣播道會客室
programme.desc: 主持林健鋒特邀財政司司長陳茂波，在品嚐沙特阿拉伯咖啡的輕鬆氛圍中，深入暢談香港未來。節目剖析司長外訪中東為香港帶來的發展機遇，並針對當前複雜的外圍經濟環境，探討如何進一步提升香港的城市競爭力。陳司長亦大方分享多年來打理香港財政的寶貴心得與經驗.

programme.title: 政正關你事 - 2025/26學年「心繫家國」聯校國民教育活動巡禮
廣東話去旅行 -- 唐代建築篇 (英文版)
programme.desc: In this episode of the Cantonese travel series "Cantonese Travelogue - Tang Dynasty Architecture," we will first head to Shanxi. Our journey in Shanxi will start from the largest city, Taiyuan, and then we will travel to various cities from there. . Although our stay in Taiyuan will be brief, there will still be plenty to see and eat. . The most famous and representative breakfast food in Taiyuan is known as "Tou Nao." This specialty snack has a history of three to four hundred years and was invented by the renowned scholar and physician Fu Shan during the late Ming dynasty. It contains lamb, lamb tail fat, yellow wine, and long yam, among other ingredients. Many locals enjoy this as their breakfast. . After Taiyuan, we will head to the ancient city of Pingyao, which was praised as the "ancient Wall Street" during the Qing dynasty. After modern revitalization, the city has retained its original appearance, including the city walls and shops. To help travelers experience ancient life, there are interactive theater performances arranged at the banks, escort agencies, and government offices. The two hosts will certainly not miss the opportunity to dress up, with one portraying an ancient general and the other a historical beauty, creating a commotion at the bank. . We also enjoyed one of the country's largest immersive theaters, "You See Pingyao," which features several large-scale dramas like "Choosing a Wife in Jin City," "Bathing the Teacher," and "Homecoming Noodle Dance," weaving together stories of Shanxi's humanity and righteousness. . In addition, the two hosts participated in a paper-cutting workshop at the Intangible Cultural Heritage Experience Center and tasted a variety of famous Shanxi noodles.

programme.title: 中華知識王
programme.sub-title: 第二集 - 製茶工藝×白釉陶瓷冷知識考驗｜千年前中國「青銅黑科技」是否穿越現代的發明？｜香港故宮博物館館長現身解讀！
programme.desc: 今集有來自不同界別市民組成的「東方微笑隊」、「中華禮儀隊」及「中華傳承隊」，並由香港故宮文化博物館館長吳志華博士擔任嘉賓評判，進行一場精彩的鬥智比賽。問題除了涵蓋國家的地理特色、古代名人、地方菜式外，亦會考一考各隊伍對《憲法》的認識。而哪一隊對傳統製茶工藝、白釉陶瓷器、昔日屯門對外經商歷史認識更多？最後一個關鍵回合「中國黑科技」所展示的青銅工具，印證國家早於外國超過一千年前已發明了這工具，究竟今集的「中國黑科技」是什麼呢？. 主持：曾卓然、糖妹、阮頌揚（知識小王子）. 嘉賓評判：吳志華（香港故宮文化博物館館長）. 參賽隊伍：東方微笑隊、中華禮儀隊、中華傳承隊. 香港電台與政制及內地事務局聯合製作，5月10日星期六晚上8時播出。. #中華知識#中華歷史#中華文化#中國黑科技#中國近代發展#青銅器#傳統製茶#白釉陶瓷器#屯門#中國文物.

programme.title: 中醫藥旗艦展新篇 (英文版)
政正關你事 - 官員講話摘要
照顧者們
programme.desc: 麥麗兒（Marine）的女兒李沛凝（Cassie）在不足27週時出生，因器官發育不全被送入深切治療部，隨後引發視膜網病變。儘管視障不致命，Cassie卻罹患罕見的先天性巨結腸症，整條大小腸缺乏神經節細胞，無法正常消化，生命危在旦夕，醫生預言她活不過十個月。經歷多次求醫，Cassie成功度過十個月的關口，但在3歲前一直住院，Marine無法回答如何熬過這段艱辛的日子，只記得醫院裡揮之不去的漂白水味道，頻繁入院讓Marine心力交瘁。. 隨著Cassie漸漸長大，終於出院回家了，並入讀心光盲人院暨學校，身體狀況開始穩定。儘管只能進食流質食物，且因治療影響學習進度，Cassie依然樂觀，滿足地說「現在就很好」。幾年前，丈夫去世，Marine不再強求甚麼，只希望Cassie健康快樂地成長。Cassie熱愛音樂，Marine全力支持她學習彈琴、唱歌和作曲。雖然Marine需兼顧工作與照顧女兒，但她希望為Cassie和其他視障學童創建NGO，提供發揮音樂才能的機會.

Connect with students from around the world and delve into their stories and experiences. Discover why Hong Kong is an ideal destination for post-secondary education and a place of opportunities.

programme.title: 大自然深度遊 (英文版)
programme.sub-title: Day and Night of Tai Tam Country Park
programme.desc: Where people live, they can be close to the natural environment. This is one of the features of Tai Tam Country Park. . In fact, Tai Tam Country Park is located in the eastern part of Hong Kong Island, accounting for one-fifth of Hong Kong Island. There are four reservoirs inside, connected by a Tai Tam Waterworks Heritage Trail. . Along the heritage trail, many of the waterworks facilities have been designated as statutory monuments. For example, stone bridges and dams made of granite have a history of more than a hundred years.

programme.title: Dream Chasers
programme.desc: 朱毅豪（Martin），香港城市大學博士、無電製冷技術研發者及創業者。. 他從小在廣州舊樓頂層長大，飽受夏日酷熱之苦，自小夢想為人們帶來清涼。憑藉對環境科學的熱忱與科研堅持，他與城大團隊從撒哈拉沙漠銀蟻的降溫機制中獲得靈感，研發出無電製冷技術，並於2022年創立公司，將實驗室成果轉化為實際產品，推動節能減排與碳中和。我們將跟隨朱毅豪的步伐，從香港獅子山走到中東沙漠，見證他如何以科技創新實現童年夢想，並將清涼帶給世界各地的人們.

programme.title: 林則徐：虎門銷煙以外
programme.desc: This episode follows Lin Zexu’s cast of mind as the first “to open his eyes to the world,” and the long resonance that crossed borders. It begins with his work compiling and translating the Gazeta de Macau e Timor, and follows the thread to Wei Yuan’s Illustrated Treatise on the Maritime Kingdoms, shaped by Lin’s efforts and later carried to Japan, where it helped inspire the Meiji Restoration. The story then moves through the careers of Zuo Zongtang, Shen Baozhen, and Yan Fu, linking the self-strengthening movement to the creation of a modern navy. It closes in the present with Hong Kong’s return and the carrier Shandong’s visit, answering the century-long quest for strength embodied by Lin Zexu, and affirming the great passage of the Chinese nation, from travail to renewal, from endurance to resurgence.

programme.title: 香港故事-從獅子山遠眺神州大地
programme.sub-title: 蜀地說與草原上的都城
programme.desc: 在中原還沒有夏朝的時候，中國西南面有一個塵封的古蜀國。因考古學家發現古時的遺址，打開了五千年前古蜀國的神秘之謎！金沙遺址，及三星堆的出土，令人更多了解古蜀國的生活面貌！. 中國每一個朝代，邊疆的統治都非常複雜，遊牧民族更是中原的最大隱憂。中國皇朝中，元朝及清朝都是外族入主中原治國，他們是怎樣選擇都城、治國的呢？. 主持:文恩澄. 嘉賓:梁萃行教授(嶺南大學歷史系系主任).

programme.title: 悅讀憲法 英文版
programme.sub-title: Ecological Guardianship — Environmental Responsibility under the Constitution
programme.desc: Lucid waters and lush mountains are invaluable assets. They represent precious resources and are a key foundation for the nation’s sustainable development. How does the Constitution provide legal safeguards and development direction for ecological conservation and resource management? This episode features an interview with hydrologist and engineer Chen Manxiang, who talks about his years of research on water resource development and utilisation in Gansu and the upper reaches of the Yellow River, and shares his contributions to natural resource conservation and ecological education. This illustrates how the Constitution safeguards the advancement of research and practice in tandem, accelerating the transition towards a green development model in the country and Hong Kong.

programme.title: 勝在有設計
programme.desc: 裝修預算愈高，用的物料當然就愈好，不過只要用得其所，有限的預算加上無限創意，一樣可以創出理想家居，今集vicky與設計師哈利，就會去到葵涌金石樓，一間40年前裝修過的舊屋，以有限預算，全屋變得美輪美奐。另外，仲會介紹可以裝在浴室的小型桑拿。.

programme.title: 馬田點食記 台灣篇
programme.desc: 隱身在巷弄中的無名麵店，從早到晚人流不斷，為的就是吃一碗外面沒有的四醬麵，秘方的醬料是老闆母親的配方，不含人工香料，有時候簡單的一碗麵就能讓人印象深刻。寧夏夜市的臭豆腐專賣店吃的是創意，不只有傳統醬油膏，還有香醇的金沙醬搭臭豆腐，甚至把臭豆腐當成內餡.

programme.desc: 深井家近年發生很多不愉快的事件，為了讓這家人重新展開新生活，改造工匠池田佳人費盡心思設計出獨一無二的家。經過改造後，她們可以在這裡重新經營雞肉串燒店及聲樂教室。居住部份亦善用每寸空間，除了保留眾人珍貴的回憶外，同時滿足四位家庭成員各自的願望。.

programme.title: 高鐵旅遊呈獻 : 臥底．高鐵團
programme.desc: 郴州臥底再次北上進行任務，全程由西九龍高鐵站出發直達目的地，第一團潛伏湖南郴州4天團，一到埗就被漫天櫻花重重包圍，妹姐置身花花世界之中難以自拔。之後又奔馳於一望無際嘅【蓼江油菜花田】，坐吉普車遊【郴州小洱海】，再坐專用攝影船近距離欣賞小東江嘅“漁夫撒.

programme.title: 關於．快樂的死亡 2

programme.title: 一個人鐵道行 3
